snippet.title: Bye Sweet Carole - Release Date Trailer
snippet.description:
Bye Sweet Carole releases on October 9! 🌹
The narrative horror game will be available on  PS5, Nintendo Switch, Xbox Series X and PC!

Step into the role of Lana Benton, a brave young girl determined to uncover the chilling truth behind the mysterious disappearance of her best friend, Carole, from the eerie Bunny Hall orphanage. 

#byesweetcarole #indiegame #narrativehorror #narrativegames #darkfantasy #atmospheric
